messages.plugin.name: MySQL Database Adapter
messages.plugin.description: Safely migrates the canonical SQLite database to a validated MySQL backend.
messages.plugin.sidebar.label: MySQL Adapter
messages.ui.mariaDbCompatibility: MariaDB operates only when it is fully compatible with MySQL. Incompatible environments are unsupported.
messages.ui.noErrorLog: No error log has been recorded.
messages.ui.manualMySql: A working manually configured MySQL backend was detected. This migration plugin is disabled and the existing connection is unchanged.
messages.ui.irreversibleWarning: After migration from {source} to {destination} succeeds, the canonical database cannot be switched back to {source}. The source database is retained but is no longer synchronized.
messages.ui.irreversibleConfirm: Migrate the canonical database from {source} to {destination}? You cannot switch it back after the migration succeeds.
messages.ui.unavailableAfterPostgreSqlMigration: MySQL is unavailable because the canonical database was migrated to PostgreSQL.
messages.ui.running: Migration is running. Writes are temporarily paused.
messages.ui.cancelRequestedDetail: The migration will stop at the next safe checkpoint. SQLite remains canonical.
messages.ui.migrationControlHelp: You can cancel until MySQL activation begins. This status updates automatically.
messages.migrationStage.waiting_for_database: Waiting for other database activity to finish
messages.migrationStage.activating: Activating MySQL as the canonical database
messages.ui.relocationHelp: Only the MySQL host and port can be changed. Confirmation tests the connection and verifies it against the canonical data.
messages.ui.endpointChangeRequired: Change the host or port before confirming.
messages.ui.testingEndpoint: Testing the new endpoint and verifying the canonical data…
messages.ui.endpointChanged: The MySQL endpoint was changed. Reloading…
